subject: How to get Phenotypic variance explained (R squared), QTL effect in RQTL2?

messages.author: 0ec64991025ef982
messages.subject: How to get Phenotypic variance explained (R squared), QTL effect in RQTL2?
parts:
Hi all,
I am relatively new to R/QTL2. I do not see the output of scan1 containing R-squared. How can we also find QTL effect i.e. slope between marker class, and additive variance explained etc. I do not see that in the user manual. Is it still under development. 

Thanks,
Bishal

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] How to get Phenotypic variance explained (R squared), QTL effect in RQTL2?
parts:
To get QTL effects, use the function scan1coef() or scan1blup() to get
estimates for all positions along a chromosome.
Or use fit1() to get the estimated coefficients at a particular position.

We don't have any functions that give additive variance explained, at
present.

karl
